title: Support for union of models (non scalars) in query string
body:
### First Check

- [X] I added a very descriptive title here.
- [X] I used the GitHub search to find a similar question and didn't find it.
- [X] I searched the FastAPI documentation, with the integrated search.
- [X] I already searched in Google "How to X in FastAPI" and didn't find any information.
- [X] I already read and followed all the tutorial in the docs and didn't find an answer.
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Pydantic](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Swagger UI](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [ReDoc](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc).

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
from typing import Annotated

import fastapi
import pydantic


class Inputs1(pydantic.BaseModel):
    a1: str
    a2: str


class Inputs2(pydantic.BaseModel):
    a1: str
    a3: str


router = fastapi.APIRouter()


@router.get("/")
def index(qs: Annotated[Inputs1 | Inputs2, fastapi.Query()]) -> None:
    pass
```


### Description

Running the code above ends with an assertion error: 

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "fa.py", line 20, in <module>
    @router.get("/")
     ~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^
  File "lib/python3.13/site-packages/fastapi/routing.py", line 1001, in decorator
    self.add_api_route(
    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^
        path,
        ^^^^^
    ...<23 lines>...
        generate_unique_id_function=generate_unique_id_function,
        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    )
    ^
  File "lib/python3.13/site-packages/fastapi/routing.py", line 940, in add_api_route
    route = route_class(
        self.prefix + path,
    ...<24 lines>...
        generate_unique_id_function=current_generate_unique_id,
    )
  File "lib/python3.13/site-packages/fastapi/routing.py", line 561, in __init__
    self.dependant = get_dependant(path=self.path_format, call=self.endpoint)
                     ~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "lib/python3.13/site-packages/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py", line 293, in get_dependant
    param_details = analyze_param(
        param_name=param_name,
    ...<2 lines>...
        is_path_param=is_path_param,
    )
  File "lib/python3.13/site-packages/fastapi/dependencies/utils.py", line 510, in analyze_param
    is_scalar_field(field)
    ...<5 lines>...
    )
AssertionError
```

Using `qs: Annotated[str|int, fastapi.Query()]` works fine. Reading the code, I understand this is a current limitation. It would be nice if this would be supported or if one has an idea about how to overcome this.

I know I can use several optional fields, with custom pydantic validator to properly implements eg. XOR, but this doesn't play well with inputs composition.

### Operating System

Linux

_No response_

### FastAPI Version

0.117.1

### Pydantic Version

2.11.9

### Python Version

3.13.5

### Additional Context

_No response_

answer.body:
huuum good point. This is actually not supported yet : https://swagger.io/docs/specification/v3_0/describing-parameters/#parameter-dependencies

There have been some discussion about adding parameters dependencies description in OpenAPI v4 but nothing there since may 2024 : https://github.com/OAI/sig-moonwalk/discussions/100
